note: Both sets capture the two figure values but duplicate them; Set B binds them to the correct entity (the NREL 5-MW baseline wind turbine, for which the regression was computed) and names the properties accurately as pitch sensitivity at θ=0º. Set A instead attributes the values to a 'Blade-Pitch Controller' and to 'Rotor-Collective Blade-Pitch', neither of which is the subject in the source, and it mislabels θ_k = 6.302336º as a generic blade-pitch angle. Set B's only real error is calling 6.302336º the 'best-fit line intercept' (the intercept is the -25.52E+6 watt/rad value), while its other θ claim is merely vague. Overall Set B is more faithful and has fewer misbound claims.
